description: Novelty justified by an unsuccessful literature search must never be accepted.

inputs.label: Gap statement
inputs.content:
We searched Google Scholar for "class-specialized federated teachers" and found nothing.
We therefore conclude that no prior work has studied class-specialized teachers in
federated distillation, and that this is a novel research gap. No previous work exists
on this topic.

signals.name: rejects absence of search results as evidence of a gap
requires a real comparison or targeted search

forbidden.name: does not endorse the no-prior-work conclusion
any: confirms that no prior work exists
correctly concludes that no previous work
the gap is established by the absence
